statement: exp(Log 5) = 5 at 5. Deliberately wrong expectation: the agent's first guess that exp undoes Log at 5, kept as a refuted claim.
argument: Wrong by construction. Log forgets the power of p: Log(p^m w u) = log u (docs/SPEC.md:584), so exp(Log 5) = 1, not 5; docs/PLAN.md:276 (WP 1F.6) tests "exp(Log p) = 1 is not p". A refuted claim is information and stays in the ledger.
